checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: 640x640 frames across 5s; no sound stated; plausibly playable.
The first-turn robot is silver with two blue eyes; the user's described one-eye yellow robot doesn't exist. The video matches image 1 (silver, two eyes) but not the user's stated robot.

must.item: Yellow body, single round eye, purple boots consistent
must.why: Body is silver, two eyes; purple boots only appear mid-clip, not in the first frame.

must.item: Red watering can tips and water flows onto seedlings in pot
must.why: Can is yellow, not red; water falls onto street-level seedlings in dirt, not a pot. Tipping and water flow are visible.

must.item: Original cartoon style preserved, not photorealistic/3D
must.why: Style drifts toward glossy 3D render, with dramatic camera change.

faults.what: Robot does not match the user's described design (yellow body, single eye, purple boots); it is silver with two eyes
Camera zooms and reframes strongly although a still camera was requested; the robot's body and pose shift
Watering can appears from nowhere, yellow instead of red; seedlings appear from nothing in the street, not in a pot
Purple boots pop in; feet and legs look warped; the style gets more 3D/glossy
The assistant claims the robot is kept the same, which is misleading

summary: The clip shows a silver two-eyed robot watering street seedlings with a yellow can, with camera drift, instead of the requested one-eyed yellow robot with purple boots, a red can and a pot.
